text:
Carlos: Heads-up 1 1 need a concise play for bundling marketplace private offers + hardware credits for SI-led renewals. Keep it 1 page.

Anya: Agreed. Reps ask whether to put partner credits directly on PO or as separate rebate. We should standardize. :white_check_mark:

Leah: Partners prefer a single combined offer for co-branded deals. They typically require a commit term (6-12mo) to enable HW credits.

Mike: Marketplace note: private offers need fixed SKUs/pricing. Flexible kicker tiers mean we must create discrete SKUs for each tier, or fallback to post-sale rebate.

Carlos: Draft framework:
- Base PO: 10% off for 12mo commit >= $100k
- SI add SKU: redeemable credit SKU (e.g., SI-CREDIT-10K)
- HW kicker SKU: partner-funded credit SKU, expires 90 days after registration

Anya: Add early-renew accelerator: +3% if renewal signed 30-60 days early. Helps retention.

Leah: Cap stacking: vendor+partner discounts <= 35%; HW credit cap $50k per account. Partners insist on caps.

Mike: We'll bake caps into SKU metadata to simplify billing. Example mapping: PRIV12-100K -> 10% off; SI-CREDIT-10K -> $10k credit; HW-KICK-50K -> $50k credit.

Carlos: Announcement rules:
- Public co-announcement only if partner approves and deal >= $500k
- SI co-marketing allowed > $100k with logo pre-clearance
- For HW bundles wait for shipment milestone before public comms

Anya: Ops tracking: use private-offer metadata + pilot reconciliation sheet.

Leah: Partners expect monthly reconciliations with line items. I'll share their CSV template after confirming.

PartnerBot: Internal template: https://redwood.internal/docs/partner/private-offer-template

Mike: Fallback for marketplaces that block combo SKUs: issue vendor post-sale rebate and document in PO notes.

Carlos: Action list:
- Anya: one-pager with ladder + renewal accelerator by Thu EOD
- Leah: confirm partner cap and reconciliation format by Fri
- Mike: SKU naming + fallback notes by Mon
- Carlos: announce gating checklist for SEs by Mon

Anya: Will add legal blurb: "Offer subject to partner co-funding and redemption terms; credits apply per SKU and expire 90 days after registration."

Leah: Looping partner ops once caps confirmed.

Mike: I'll include sample JSON metadata for PO notes: {"max_total_discount_pct":"35","hw_credit_cap_usd":"50000"}

Carlos: Pilot with two SI-led renewals next month. Update in 2 weeks. :thumbsup:

Leah: :thumbsup:

Anya: Posting one-pager in #partnerships when ready.

PartnerBot: Reminder set: follow-up 7 days before pilot start.
